description: She wears an opaque deep green floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and full skirt. Tan-gold knotwork bands decorate the neckline, shoulders, cuffs, vertical front band and hem. A cream underdress shows through a modest opening from below the knee. A matching patterned green belt closes at a round bronze-toned knotwork buckle, with two similar shoulder clasps. A dark green patterned wool wrap with fringed ends rests across her forearms. Brown leather shoes and a small finger ring are visible. No headgear or weapon is visible.
